=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's weapon exactly as shown in the provided reference.
Keep the weapon visually consistent throughout the entire video.
Do not redesign or alter the weapon.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the present-day environment.

Use the provided Father reference
only for Riven's brief memory.

Use the provided final frame from Scene 36
only to maintain spatial continuity at the beginning.

The present scene continues inside
the same damaged burning wooden building.

Maintain the same warm orange firelight,
heavy smoke,
broken wood,
ash,
and debris.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Restrained emotional performance.

Natural physical movement.

Cinematic but controlled camera movement.

Natural fire,
heavy breathing,
wood creaking,
distant destruction,
distant civilians,
and environmental sound.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No magical activation.

No glowing runes.

No power-up.

Only Father's memory voice is heard.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue directly after Scene 36.

Riven remains exhausted
inside the damaged burning building.

The painful memories from the previous scene
are still affecting her.

Then one specific memory of her father returns.

His words remind Riven
why she once chose to fight:

"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."

Back in the present,
Riven hears civilians
still trying to escape the burning settlement.

She realizes there are still people alive
who need protection.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains ahead of her.

Riven chooses to stand again.

There is no power-up.

She simply refuses to remain down.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — WHY SHE FOUGHT ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY
on an extreme close-up of Riven's face
from the front.

Do not recreate the final composition
of Scene 36.

The previous scene ended
from behind and beside Riven,
with the Mysterious Dark Figure
blurred in the smoke ahead.

Now cut much closer.

Only Riven's face,
her eyes,
and part of her hair
fill the frame.


Her head is slightly lowered.

Warm orange firelight
flickers across her face.

Her breathing is heavy.

She is physically exhausted
and emotionally shaken.


For a brief moment,

Riven remains completely still.


The sounds of the burning building
slowly become distant and muffled.


Her eyes slowly lift.


Then—


MEMORY FLASH.


Use the provided Father reference.


A very brief memory
of her father before he was lost.

Keep the memory simple and short.

Do not expand it
into a complete flashback scene.


Over the memory,

her father's voice returns:


"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."


FLASH OUT.


CUT BACK TO PRESENT.


Extreme close-up of Riven's eyes.


The sound remains quiet
for a brief moment.


The words stay with her.


Her expression changes subtly.


Not anger.

Not sudden confidence.


A quiet realization.


=== SHOT 2 — SOMEONE IS STILL ALIVE ===

The sound of the present
slowly returns.


Fire.

Breaking wood.

Wind through the damaged building.


Then—


distant frightened voices outside.


Riven hears them.


Her attention shifts.


She slowly turns her head
toward the broken opening.


CUT to a new angle
looking past Riven toward the settlement outside.


Through smoke and firelight,

a small number of civilians
are still escaping
from the burning settlement.


Some move quickly.

One person helps another
toward safety.


Keep them distant.

Keep the moment simple.

Do not turn this into a large crowd scene.


CUT back to Riven.


She watches them.


They are still alive.


Riven turns her eyes
back toward the Mysterious Dark Figure.


The figure remains ahead
within the smoke.


Riven looks at the figure.


Then briefly toward
the escaping civilians behind her.


No dialogue.


Riven understands
what she has to do.


=== SHOT 3 — STAND AGAIN ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
slowly begins moving toward Riven.


Riven looks down
at the weapon in her hand.


Her fingers tighten around the grip.


Nothing happens to the weapon.


No magical energy.

No glowing runes.


Riven plants her free hand
against the debris.


She begins forcing herself upward.


The movement is difficult.


Her body is exhausted.


She struggles to rise—


but continues.


Riven finally reaches her feet.


She steadies herself.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
is ahead of her.


The escaping civilians
are behind her.


Riven is now standing
between them.


She raises her weapon
into a simple defensive fighting stance.


She is still hurt.

Still exhausted.

Still physically outmatched.


But she does not move away.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
slowly comes to a stop.


Riven holds her ground.


No dialogue.


No power-up.


No magical activation.


Hold the confrontation briefly.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven is standing again.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is ahead of her.

The escaping civilians
are behind Riven.

Riven has deliberately placed herself
between the figure
and the people escaping the settlement.

She remains injured and exhausted.

Her weapon remains exactly consistent
with the provided reference.

There is no magical energy yet.

There is no rune activation yet.

Riven has chosen to fight
before receiving any new power.

CUT.
